task: Classify held-out genomic windows containing a peak in one human tibial-nerve Schwann ATAC pseudobulk
negative_design: Random same-chromosome windows excluding any unthresholded/pseudoreplicated peak with 1000 bp buffer, blacklist, gaps and ambiguous sequence. Preserve natural GC differences for primary benchmark; assess GC-matched negatives as sensitivity.
deduplication: Merge overlapping positive windows before sampling; exclude overlaps between selected examples; reverse-complement canonical sequence hashes audited across splits
selection: Validation average precision; no test-set parameter choice
uncertainty: 500 paired bootstrap draws of 1 Mb genomic blocks on held-out chromosomes; report 95% percentile intervals and AP difference versus GC_CpG
null: One training-label permutation, predeclared seed, same validation procedure; not a biological significance test
pretrained_gate: PMP22 overlaps Borzoi fold7 (training in standard released replicates; test fold3, validation fold4). Those models are ineligible for an independent PMP22 genomic test. This benchmark trains new transparent models from scratch. It does not claim a comparison against Borzoi/AlphaGenome/ChromBPNet.
